channel.title: Antonio José García Arias (Toni) — Engineering Field Notes
channel.description: Field notes from building products end to end: real-time concurrency, local-first daemons, proprietary vision models, and lessons learned along the way.

item.title: From WhatsApp Chaos to Real-time Auctions: Engineering the F1-BUGAMBRA Live Bidding Engine
item.description: How we replaced a chaotic messaging group with a production real-time auction engine using WebSockets, monotonic clock anti-sniping timers, and double-checked lock concurrency.

item.title: Why Local-First Daemons Beat Cloud Microservices for Personal Inbox Automation
item.description: Analyzing the reliability, privacy guarantees, and token durability of building GmailKeeper as a local background daemon rather than a hosted multi-tenant cloud service.

item.title: Custom Models vs. Third-Party APIs: Why CleverTracker Trains Its Own Vision Models
item.description: The architectural tradeoffs between calling external LLM vision endpoints and training custom lightweight models for a 681,000 product food catalog.
